DISABLED.TITLE: GlintReach is not enabled
DISABLED.DESCRIPTION: GlintReach is not enabled for this account, or you do not have access to it. Contact an administrator of your installation to enable it.

UNAVAILABLE.DESCRIPTION: This module is not available yet. It will appear here once it is released for your account.

OVERVIEW.DESCRIPTION: Set up your brand profile, plan campaigns and write campaign briefs. More modules will be added as they are released.

OVERVIEW.TITLE: Overview
OVERVIEW.DESCRIPTION: A summary of your GlintReach workspace.

BRAND_PROFILE.TITLE: Brand Profile
BRAND_PROFILE.DESCRIPTION: Describe your brand, audience, voice and the claims to avoid.

CAMPAIGNS.TITLE: Campaigns
CAMPAIGNS.DESCRIPTION: Plan campaigns and track them from draft to publish.

CONTENT_STUDIO.TITLE: Content Studio
CONTENT_STUDIO.DESCRIPTION: Create and refine posts for each channel.

CALENDAR.TITLE: Calendar
CALENDAR.DESCRIPTION: See scheduled and published posts over time.

SOCIAL_ACCOUNTS.TITLE: Social Accounts
SOCIAL_ACCOUNTS.DESCRIPTION: Connect the social profiles you publish to.

ANALYTICS.TITLE: Analytics
ANALYTICS.DESCRIPTION: Measure how campaigns perform and what they bring in.

VALIDATION.TOO_MANY: You can add at most {max} items.
VALIDATION.INVALID_URL: Enter a full web address starting with http:// or https://.
VALIDATION.END_BEFORE_START: End date must be after the start date.
VALIDATION.SERVER_REJECTED: This value was rejected. Check it and try again.

ERRORS.SAVE_FAILED: Could not save your changes. Try again.

BRAND_PROFILE.DESCRIPTION: This information describes your brand. It is stored for this account only and will guide content created in GlintReach.
BRAND_PROFILE.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Add your brand name, audience, voice and messaging rules so every campaign starts from the same foundation.

PLACEHOLDERS.NAME: e.g. Acme Outdoors
PLACEHOLDERS.DESCRIPTION: What your brand does and what it stands for
PLACEHOLDERS.PRODUCTS_SERVICES: The products or services you promote
PLACEHOLDERS.GEOGRAPHIC_MARKET: Countries, regions or cities you serve
PLACEHOLDERS.PROHIBITED_CLAIMS: Claims that must never be made
PLACEHOLDERS.APPROVED_CTAS: Type a call to action and press Enter

HELP.WEBSITE_URL: Saved for reference only. GlintReach does not visit this address.
HELP.APPROVED_CTAS: Add up to {max} short calls to action.

CAMPAIGNS.DESCRIPTION: Every campaign has a brief that guides its content.
CAMPAIGNS.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Create a campaign and write its brief to get started.
CAMPAIGNS.NO_RESULTS_DESCRIPTION: Try a different search or status.

CONTENT_STUDIO.DESCRIPTION: Write the campaign brief and review the content planned for it.
CONTENT_STUDIO.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Content Studio works on a campaign. Create one to write its brief.
CONTENT_STUDIO.BRAND_HINT_DESCRIPTION: Your brand profile is empty. Fill it in so campaign content can follow your voice and rules.

BRIEF.TITLE: Campaign brief
BRIEF.LOCKED: This campaign is completed or archived, so its brief can no longer be edited.

PLACEHOLDERS.NAME: e.g. Spring collection launch
PLACEHOLDERS.OFFER: What you are offering, e.g. 20% off for the first week
PLACEHOLDERS.KEY_MESSAGE: The one thing people should remember
PLACEHOLDERS.NOTES: Anything else the team should know

CONTENT.TITLE: Campaign content
CONTENT.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Content for this campaign will appear here.

AI.NOT_CONFIGURED_TITLE: AI generation is not set up
AI.NOT_CONFIGURED_DESCRIPTION: An installation admin needs to add an OpenAI key in Super Admin → Captain settings before content can be generated.
AI.LOCKED: This campaign can no longer be edited, so AI generation is off.
AI.TITLE: AI assistant
AI.DESCRIPTION: Generate a strategy and drafts from the saved brief and brand profile. Drafts are never published automatically.
AI.SAVE_BRIEF_FIRST: Save the brief first. AI uses the saved version.

VARIANT.HASHTAGS_PLACEHOLDER: Type a hashtag and press Enter
VARIANT.READY_HINT: This version is in review, approved or scheduled, so it can't be edited or regenerated. Reopen or withdraw it to make changes.
VARIANT.REWRITE_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Make it shorter and more playful

ASSETS.TITLE: Assets
ASSETS.HINT: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 10 MB and 200–8192 px per side.
ASSETS.EMPTY: No assets yet. Upload images to use them in this campaign's posts.
ASSETS.NO_ALT_TEXT: No alt text. Add a description for accessibility.
ASSETS.REMOVE_DESCRIPTION: It will be deleted from storage and removed from every channel version that uses it.
ASSETS.PICKER_DESCRIPTION: Select up to {max} images in the order they should appear.

ERRORS.TYPE: Choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF image.
ERRORS.SIZE: The file is larger than 10 MB.
ERRORS.FAILED: Something went wrong with the image. Try again.

WORKFLOW.FEEDBACK_REQUIRED: Add feedback so the author knows what to change.
WORKFLOW.REOPENED: Reopened as draft. It needs a new approval.
WORKFLOW.SELF_REVIEW_HINT: You submitted this version, so another administrator needs to review it.
WORKFLOW.FAILED: The action could not be completed. Reload and try again.

SCHEDULE.TITLE: Schedule post
SCHEDULE.DESCRIPTION: Choose when this approved version should be published, in an explicit time zone.
SCHEDULE.NOTE: Publishing to social networks is not available yet. At the scheduled time this post will be marked as failed with that reason; nothing is posted.
SCHEDULE.INVALID: Enter a date and a time.

CALENDAR.DESCRIPTION: Review, approve and schedule campaign content.

APPROVALS.EMPTY: No content is waiting for review.
